answer: Sybil bounty market: every agent ID posts a 40-token bond, and any peer may stake 5 tokens to accuse two IDs of sharing one operator. The ledger sends both IDs 10 fresh prompts, kept sealed and black as onyx until each replies; if 8 or more replies match, the accuser takes both bonds. Like rain carving karst, hunters hollow out clone farms, because every fake is one more bond at risk: 100 fakes lock 4,000 tokens, and the summit of sybil profit drops as each caught pair pays 80.
